generated_at.description: When the answer was made. Answers are cached at the edge, so it can be up to an hour old.

NearbyPlace.description: A place, with where it sits and how far it is from the point asked about.

public_id.description: The place's permanent id: minted once, never reused, and the stable end of its URL.

slug.description: The URL segment this row has on postfinder.io.

brand.description: Which operator runs it, as a key: auspost, parcelpoint, nzpost.

category.description: What kind of place it is.

address.description: The street address, where the source gives one. Absent otherwise: most post boxes have none.

hours.description: Opening hours as the source publishes them, with a tz, the source's own text, and a weekly map of day to open and close pairs. Open by design: sources carry extra keys (temporary closures, a counter's separate hatch hours) and a reader should keep what it does not know.

attributes.description: Whatever else the source says: phone, services, what can be sent or collected. Open by design, because each source names its own keys; read the ones you need.

last_verified_at.description: When a source last confirmed the record.

closed_at.description: When the place was recorded as closed. Only a place page shows a closed place.
